_comment: The REQUESTED -> APPROVED/REJECTED lifecycle for a cashier-created refund, added in Stage 4 remediation pass 3. Complements refund-regression-monday-friday.json (which shows an immediate-execution refund). Symmetric to void-approval-workflow.json.

step_1_cashier_requests._note: items/settlements are empty arrays at REQUESTED time -- refund_item/refund_settlement rows are only created at APPROVED -> COMPLETED (state-machines.md SS3). The disposition/quantity/payment_method/amount given here are retained pending execution but are not yet committed domain rows, so they cannot yet carry the ids a RefundItem/RefundSettlement schema requires.

step_3_manager_approves._note: terminal_id/fiscal_day_id/shift_id are the APPROVING manager's own currently-open terminal/fiscal_day/shift -- terminal-2, distinct from the original sale's terminal-1 (the Monday-sale/Friday-refund pattern from refund-regression-monday-friday.json, here compressed to the same day for brevity). items/settlements are populated only now, using exactly the disposition/quantity/payment_method/amount supplied at step_1 -- never re-solicited at approval time.

step_3b_manager_rejects_instead._comment: Alternative to step_3 -- shown for completeness.

body.reason: Item shows normal wear, not a manufacturing defect; declined per store policy

conflict_example_409.description: Approve attempted against a refund that already resolved (COMPLETED, REJECTED, or already re-approved by a concurrent request)

error.message: This refund has already been resolved and is no longer pending approval.

execution_time_condition_example_409.description: Approve attempted while the approving manager's own terminal has no open fiscal_day/shift right now -- unlike Void, Refund does not auto-downgrade to REJECTED on this condition (see refundApprove's description in openapi.yaml); it fails with the same error the original request-time endpoint already documents.

error.message: The approving terminal has no open shift; open a shift before approving this refund.
